title: Backlink Gap Prospecting
summary: Compare referring-domain evidence for a target and confirmed competitors, then qualify a bounded set of relevant outreach prospects.

required_inputs.description: The target domain whose backlink gaps and prospect opportunities should be evaluated.

scope.guidance: Discover and confirm no more than three competitors whose link evidence is relevant to the target market.

evidence_plan.condition: Use server discovery when the user has not supplied a sufficiently relevant competitor set.

completion_without.limitation: The method requires user-supplied competitor domains that can be confirmed as relevant.

evidence_plan.fallback: Use only user-supplied competitors that available evidence confirms; otherwise stop incomplete.

scope.guidance: Accept no more than three user-supplied competitor domains for relevance confirmation.

completion_without.limitation: Competitors must instead be discovered and confirmed through the connected server.

evidence_plan.fallback: Use the server discovery path and preserve its relevance limitations.

scope.guidance: Retrieve comparable referring-domain evidence for the target and no more than three confirmed competitors.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot establish a backlink gap without comparable target and competitor link sets.

evidence_plan.fallback: Return an incomplete opportunity set rather than infer link gaps from authority or search visibility alone.

scope.guidance: Measure no more than twenty finalist referring domains whose authority can change qualification or priority.

evidence_plan.condition: Use authority metrics only when they can change finalist qualification or ordering.

completion_without.limitation: Prospects are ranked by observed relevance and link evidence without a quantitative authority comparison.

evidence_plan.fallback: Lower confidence where authority evidence is material and rank by supported relevance and source context.

scope.guidance: Read one representative source page for each of no more than twenty finalist domains.

completion_without.limitation: The method cannot qualify topical relevance, outreach angle, or disqualifying context without source-page evidence.

evidence_plan.fallback: If no finalist source page can be read, return incomplete; otherwise narrow the completed set to candidates whose source context was observed.

steps.instruction: Confirm the target domain, market, relevant topics, existing assets, outreach constraints, and intended decision.
Inspect current runtime cost and authorization for competitor discovery, backlink-set retrieval, and qualification.
Use user-confirmed competitors or discover and validate a bounded set whose links are relevant to the target's market.
Retrieve bounded referring-domain evidence for the target and confirmed competitors with comparable conditions.
Identify domains that support relevant competitors but not the target, then rank candidates by supported relevance and authority evidence.
Inspect finalist source context, topical relevance, plausible outreach angle, and disqualifying evidence.
Return qualified prospects with source URL, linked competitor, authority evidence, relevance, angle, contact route when observed, confidence, and rejection reason.

evidence_requirements: Each prospect is supported by an observed link to a relevant confirmed competitor.
Authority metrics record their source, freshness, and limitations.
Relevance and outreach angle are interpretations linked to source context.
Contact information is reported only when lawfully and directly observed; it is never invented.
stop_conditions: Stop before paid backlink retrieval when authorization is insufficient.
Stop or narrow when no relevant competitor set can be confirmed.
Reject sources with unsupported relevance, unsafe outreach implications, or insufficient evidence.
Return an empty completed opportunity set when no prospect survives qualification.
completion_criteria: The target, competitors, data conditions, and comparison logic are recorded.
Every included prospect has link evidence, relevance, qualification, confidence, and constraints.
No more than twenty qualified prospects are returned.

bounds.sample_guidance: Qualify the strongest bounded gap candidates instead of returning an unreviewed backlink export.
